notes:
A legal term for an organization formed by a group of people (as opposed to ⟦{財団|ざいだん}→財団：11331_zaidan⟧, which is formed around assets/property). Very commonly seen in official organizational names.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {社団|しゃだん}⟦{法人|ほうじん}→法人：13298_houjin⟧: incorporated association (the full legal entity type)
- {一般|いっぱん}{社団|しゃだん}{法人|ほうじん}: general incorporated association
- ⟦{公益|こうえき}→公益：16061_koueki⟧{社団|しゃだん}⟦{法人|ほうじん}→法人：13298_houjin⟧: public interest incorporated association

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{財団|ざいだん}→財団：11331_zaidan⟧: foundation — a legal entity organized around a pool of assets or endowment, rather than members
- ⟦{法人|ほうじん}→法人：13298_houjin⟧: legal entity, corporation — a broader term for any entity with legal personhood
- NPO{法人|ほうじん}: NPO, nonprofit organization — a separate legal category for nonprofits
